Reviewed: 2026-10-17. Requirements-first model written from PRODUCT.md, ROADMAP.md, BACKLOG.md, docs/ux-implementation/dibayar-implementation-spec.md, SPEC_RECONCILIATION.md, docs/validation/M4-READINESS.md, SECURITY.md, CLAUDE.md and issues #53/#55, before the UI was inspected. Proposed by the 2026-10-17 completeness audit; every classification is a proposal for the product owner (Chris) to confirm or change.

What a creator must be able to do, kept independently of the screens and of the user-action inventory (`docs/testing/journey-coverage.json`). The inventory can only list actions the UI offers; this matrix also lists what the UI does not offer. **Covered** means at least one mapped inventory action is driven for real by a browser test or verified by a person, or a manual check is named. It does not mean every part of the capability works: see the partial evidence column and the gaps.

## Summary

- Capabilities: **46** (REQUIRED 35, PROPOSED 4, UNKNOWN 4, NOT_APPLICABLE 3)
- REQUIRED and covered: **31/35**
- REQUIRED with an open gap: **4**
- REQUIRED with no action at all in the inventory: **4** (CAP-DEAL-09, CAP-INV-02, CAP-INV-03, CAP-INV-10)

| CAP-ACC-01 | Is self-service account deletion (and its effect on issued invoices) required for the MVP, e.g. under Indonesia's personal-data law? Needs an owner/legal decision. Not built today. | Chris |
| CAP-DEAL-10 | Is a lost/cancelled outcome needed (stage, archive, or delete via CAP-DEAL-09)? Today such a deal stays in Masuk/Nego and stays eligible for '3 deal terdekat' (only Dibayar is excluded: src/components/home/nearest-deals.tsx), where it shows as overdue once its deadline passes. Ask in M4 sessions. | Chris |
| CAP-INV-13 | Should marking the invoice paid offer or perform the move to Dibayar (and the reverse)? Two independent states can disagree on Beranda and the board. | Chris |
| CAP-HOME-05 | Does 'manual entry first' mean manual non-deal income entry is in the MVP? The MVP solution list does not include it. | Chris |
